scenes.title: Years of judgment, written down nowhere
scenes.subtitle: A screen recording shows what the expert did. Never why.
scenes.footer: Hack-Nation 7 · Challenge 01 · All data in this video is synthetic

scenes.line: I watch an expert work, ask why at the pauses, and coach the next person.

captions.text: Three stages on one rail: Show → Reflect → Pass it on.
Clipa, the teal paperclip, guides each one.

scenes.heading: 1 · Show
scenes.badge: Simulated input: screen events and answers posted as text · synthetic data

captions.text: 1 · Show: the expert works through the task in the demo workspace.
Clipa stays quiet while the expert types.

scenes.heading: 1 · Show
scenes.badge: Simulated input: screen events and answers posted as text · synthetic data

captions.text: The typing stops. Clipa waits for a natural pause.
Clipa, at the pause: “What determines whether you put customer_07’s delivery address and time window in the email text or leave them in the attachment?”
Expert: “… The image can stay as an extra; what matters is that the address and the delivery time are written in the email text.”

scenes.heading: 2 · Reflect
scenes.badge: Simulated input: screen events and answers posted as text · synthetic data

captions.text: 2 · Reflect: Clipa turns the session into a Work Map.
Steps, judgment calls and guardrails, with each rule in the expert’s words.

scenes.heading: 2 · Reflect
scenes.badge: Simulated input: screen events and answers posted as text · synthetic data

captions.text: An open point: “Why must the address and delivery time appear in the email text when the attached image contains them?”
Expert: “Because customer_07 asked us to send the delivery address and time as text in the email. Only for them; an extra image is fine.”

scenes.heading: 2 · Reflect
scenes.badge: Simulated input: screen events and answers posted as text · synthetic data

captions.text: The teach-back: Clipa reads back what she understood.
Expert: “One correction: it is the delivery time window, not only the date.”

scenes.heading: 2 · Reflect
scenes.badge: Simulated input: screen events and answers posted as text · synthetic data

captions.text: Clipa: “Clarified that the email must include the delivery time window, not only the date. Everything else remains as recorded.”
The expert presses Confirm: the map is confirmed, not written afterwards.

scenes.heading: 3 · Pass it on
scenes.badge: Simulated input: screen events and answers posted as text · synthetic data

captions.text: 3 · Pass it on: a new hire, a new case for customer_07.
The draft only says “see the attached delivery summary”.

scenes.heading: 3 · Pass it on
scenes.badge: Simulated input: screen events and answers posted as text · synthetic data

captions.text: The new hire moves to Send. Clipa checks the expert’s confirmed rules.
Before Send, Clipa steps in: “The expert would stop here before sending and ask: why do you think this draft is ready to send?”

scenes.heading: 3 · Pass it on
scenes.badge: Simulated input: screen events and answers posted as text · synthetic data

captions.text: She warns. She never clicks for you or blocks another app.
The new hire adds the address and time as text.

scenes.heading: 3 · Pass it on
scenes.badge: Simulated input: screen events and answers posted as text · synthetic data

captions.text: customer_03, the same image-only email: the expert’s rule is only for customer_07.
No warning: the rule does not apply here.

scenes.heading: Off the record
scenes.badge: Simulated input: screen events and answers posted as text · synthetic data

captions.text: Off the record stops the screen and the voice at once.
It does not recall what was already sent.

scenes.headline: Clipa. The expert's judgment, passed on.
lines: Clipa learns how your best people decide, teaches it to the next person, and turns it into agents that ask before they break your rules.
scenes.note: Synthetic data. The expert’s and the new hire’s answers were scripted for this recording. Masks protect the screen, not speech.
